Safety bulletin SB-0947: Hot work permits
# Safety bulletin SB-0947: Hot work permits
Welding, grinding and cutting outside the workshops need a hot work permit from the shift supervisor.
Remove or cover combustible material within 10 meters, keep a fire extinguisher at the work site and post a fire watch for 60 minutes after the work ends.
Hot work on a line that has carried oil or solvent also needs a gas test before the permit is signed.
The permit is valid for one shift.
If the work isn't finished by the end of the shift, the next shift supervisor issues a new permit after checking the site again.

Safety bulletin SB-0950: Chemical cleaning of strainers
# Safety bulletin SB-0950: Chemical cleaning of strainers
Some sites descale seal-water strainer screens with citric acid solution.
Wear chemical goggles and nitrile gloves, and mix the solution in the workshop, never at the pump.
Rinse the screen with clean water before refitting it; acid left on the screen attacks the mechanical seal's elastomers.
WI-FS-031 describes the strainer cleaning itself.

Safety bulletin SB-0901: Confined space entry
# Safety bulletin SB-0901: Confined space entry
Pump pits, tanks and valve chambers are confined spaces.
Enter one only with a confined space permit, a gas test that shows at least 19.5 percent oxygen and no flammable or toxic gas, and an attendant who stays outside.
The attendant keeps a log of everyone inside and calls the emergency team if anyone inside stops responding.
The attendant never goes in to rescue.

CP-200 Troubleshooting Guide › 2 Controller error codes › Error E-301: suction pressure sensor fault
## Error E-301: suction pressure sensor fault
Error E-301 means the signal from suction pressure transmitter PT-11 is outside 4 to 20 mA.
The pump keeps running without low-suction protection, so the controller raises an alarm.
Causes, most likely first:
1. A broken transmitter cable.
2. A failed transmitter.
Check the cable and replace PT-11 if its output stays out of range.
